problem.variables: 28 layers x 128 binary q/k/v/o/gate/up/down role choices = 3584
problem.objective: maximize sum of source-only normalized local activation-diagonal 4->8 benefit over exactly 28 chosen source tensors
constraints: exactly 28 n8 tensor roles (168 packed Q4)
measured-stage predicted serial and/or async single decode limits
problem.solver: scipy.optimize.milp HiGHS integer, integrality all 1, no post-model-output tuning, status0/gap<=1e-8 needed for exact-proxy-optimality

cost_model.stage_order: RMSNorm -> Q/K/V native serial or bounded async join -> attention -> o_proj -> residual -> RMSNorm -> gate/up join -> SwiGLU -> down_proj -> residual
cost_model.native_threads: parallel native q4 uses separate role-indexed pools, never concurrent use shared pool
cost_model.serial_stage: observed serial_q4_6t_ms from same source role0 tensor stages + measured o/down serial native kernel medians
cost_model.async_stage: observed best of measured serial/parallel per QKV or gate/up combination + measured o/down
cost_model.calibration: old allQ4 full decode 75.26ms and known seed73 fixed role-balanced random native repacked decode 116.18ms; gamma from original serial-stage delta, before new eval
cost_model.not_full_model_async_performance: async result is model estimate only until integrated and evaluated

metrics: first full-vocab logits relative L2 and KL
single token best3 native CPU bench

limitation: Diagonal approximation of local projection error is NOT causal final-model output sensitivity; no final IID/OOD, unknown V6 used rows. Never claim full-model async achieved using only stage cost measurements.
